package.name: turtlebot_demos
package.description:
Progressive learning demos for TurtleBot AMR.
BUILDS ON ROS2_kits_ws FOUNDATION: - Demo 1 (Teleop + TF) -> builds on learning_tf - Demo 2 (ros2_control) -> builds on learning_lifecycle - Demo 3 (Sensor Fusion) -> builds on learning_comms - Demo 4 (SLAM Mapping) -> builds on learning_lifecycle - Demo 5 (Nav2 Basics) -> builds on learning_execution - Demo 6 (Full Autonomy) -> builds on learning_integration
Includes failure injection scripts to teach debugging.
